description: Promotes hidden tools into the advertised tool list for the rest of this session, so the client sees their real typed schemas instead of routing through call_tool. Pass explicit names, a query to activate the top matches of a catalogue search, or a bundle to load a whole task menu at once (task-orient, task-rough-cut, task-cut-dialogue, task-caption, task-grade, task-motion, task-conform-deliver, task-review-notes, or core; "grade" or "grading" also works). Warns once the list passes ~50 tools. Emits a tools/list_changed notification, so a client that follows the MCP spec re-lists automatically. Returns the measured context cost of the new list, because growing the menu is a real cost and should be visible rather than silent. Refuses any tool an authority boundary excludes (read-only profile, explicit allowlist, or exclusion veto) and says which. Activation is session state and is never persisted -- restarting the server returns exactly the configured profile.

bundle.description: A task menu to load whole, e.g. "task-grade" or "grade"

limit.description: With query: how many matches to activate (default 8, max 50)

names.description: Exact tool names to advertise, e.g. ["normalize_loudness","loudness_report"]

query.description: Instead of names: activate the best catalogue matches for this keyword (same ranking as find_tool)

name: activate_tools
